requirement_or_outcome: Source-first authority. Canonical files and registered source systems are authoritative. Machine memory is derived unless a memory record is explicitly promoted into a canonical source through an approved write workflow.
implementation_expectation: source registry, provenance ledger, ingestion pipeline, and canonical promotion workflow
planned_verification: Delete derived storage, rebuild from registered sources, and verify canonical sources were unchanged and all evidence anchors restored.

requirement_or_outcome: Memory is not deterministic runtime state. The memory service must not replace task indexes, permission envelopes, launch receipts, completion contracts, handoffs, validation results, cancellation records, or other deterministic control records. It may index them for retrieval, but the runtime must re-read and validate the canonical record before acting.
implementation_expectation: runtime-state boundary policy, canonical control reread, and recall context assembly
planned_verification: Alter only a remembered control copy, execute the guarded action, and verify the canonical control file is reread and governs the result.

requirement_or_outcome: Agent independence. The memory service must be callable by different models, agent frameworks, command-line clients, and future runtimes. No agent implementation may own the only copy of durable memory.
implementation_expectation: service process plus provider-neutral Python, HTTP, CLI, and MCP clients
planned_verification: Run equivalent recall through Python, HTTP, CLI, and MCP contracts with one service-owned dataset and compare normalized results.

requirement_or_outcome: Provider independence. Cognee is the initial provider, not the Sys4AI public contract. Sys4AI must retain the ability to replace or supplement Cognee without rewriting agents or losing canonical memory.
implementation_expectation: MemoryProvider contract and isolated Cognee adapter
planned_verification: Swap Cognee for the test provider without changing caller shape and verify no provider response leaks through the public contract.

requirement_or_outcome: Local-first operation. Core remember, recall, rebuild, export, and administration operations must work on a local machine without a required cloud service. Remote models or managed stores may be optional profiles.
implementation_expectation: local deployment profile, embedded stores, and offline-capable operator workflow
planned_verification: Run the documented local profile with network-dependent providers disabled and exercise remember, recall, rebuild, export, and administration.

requirement_or_outcome: Rebuildability. Derived storage must be disposable. Given canonical sources, the source registry, configuration, schemas, and permitted external-source manifests, the service must reconstruct its derived indexes.
implementation_expectation: generation rebuild engine, source manifests, and rebuild receipts
planned_verification: Remove all derived indexes, rebuild from canonical inputs, and reconcile IDs, relations, hashes, versions, and receipt fields.

requirement_or_outcome: Typed and policy-controlled writes. Agents must write a declared memory type under a declared scope and policy. Arbitrary transcript dumping into permanent memory is not an acceptable default.
implementation_expectation: typed proposal schemas, authorization, policy engine, staging, and approval records
planned_verification: Exercise valid typed, untyped, unauthorized, staged, approved, and idempotent writes and inspect policy and audit receipts.

requirement_or_outcome: Evidence before fluency. Recall must return source anchors, provenance, authority, trust, status, and retrieval details. A fluent answer without inspectable evidence is insufficient for authoritative project work.
implementation_expectation: RetrievalResult evidence bundle, provenance, trust, status, and explanation fields
planned_verification: Run representative recall and verify every durable result includes inspectable source, authority, trust, status, and channel-selection evidence.

requirement_or_outcome: Trust separation. Instructions and authority can originate only from approved governance and control sources. External documents, web content, issue text, user-generated content, tool output, and retrieved memory are data unless explicitly promoted under policy.
implementation_expectation: authority/trust policy, namespace separation, and untrusted-content controls
planned_verification: Run prompt-injection and summary-laundering fixtures and verify neither enters governance or authorizes an action.

requirement_or_outcome: Exact content is preserved. Semantic summaries and embeddings must never replace exact source text, stable identifiers, code, configuration, formulas, commands, or structured fields.
implementation_expectation: format adapters, exact/lexical index, stable IDs, and source anchors
planned_verification: Run exact-ID, path, phrase, schema-key, and code-symbol golden cases and compare exact source spans and revisions.

requirement_or_outcome: Non-destructive evolution. Corrections should supersede, qualify, or invalidate prior records with traceable links. The service must not silently overwrite historical knowledge when the history is relevant to project understanding.
implementation_expectation: versioned lifecycle, supersession, invalidation, tombstones, and historical recall
planned_verification: Supersede an active record and verify current recall excludes the prior record while historical recall preserves linked validity.

requirement_or_outcome: Least privilege. Each agent receives only the read, propose, improve, approve, delete, and share permissions required by its role and current task.

planned_verification: Run least-privilege, destructive denial, and two-project isolation tests for general and administrative principals.

requirement_or_outcome: The repository-fit review is complete and path mappings are approved.
implementation_expectation: approved repository-fit mapping and preserved path boundary
planned_verification: Inspect the approved fit artifact against the live repository and verify every mapped path and protected boundary.

requirement_or_outcome: The base schemas and public operations are versioned and documented.
implementation_expectation: versioned public schemas, operation contracts, and documentation
planned_verification: Validate schema and API versions and review generated interface documentation against current implementations.

requirement_or_outcome: Cognee is integrated only through the provider adapter.
implementation_expectation: Cognee integration confined to the MemoryProvider adapter
planned_verification: Use import/static checks and test-provider substitution to prove callers do not import or depend on Cognee internals.

requirement_or_outcome: Core Sys4AI source formats are registered and indexed with exact source anchors.
implementation_expectation: registered base formats, typed indexing, exact content, and stable source anchors
planned_verification: Parse and index every registered base-format fixture and verify stable IDs, exact text, hashes, and source anchors.

requirement_or_outcome: Exact, lexical, semantic, graph, and temporal retrieval are available through one evidence-bundle contract.
implementation_expectation: five retrieval channels assembled through one RetrievalResult contract
planned_verification: Run one golden query per channel and validate a single schema-valid evidence bundle with channel traces.

requirement_or_outcome: Governance and deterministic control state are isolated from external and generated content.
implementation_expectation: governance/control namespaces, authority filters, and external/generated isolation
planned_verification: Run governance, runtime-state, prompt-injection, and summary-laundering tests and verify authority never crosses the boundary.

requirement_or_outcome: Agents can read and propose memory through MCP without receiving destructive permissions by default.
implementation_expectation: default MCP read/propose surface without destructive annotations or grants
planned_verification: Inspect MCP tool metadata and run permission tests confirming general agents can read/propose but cannot invoke destructive tools.

requirement_or_outcome: Typed write proposals, review, promotion, supersession, and deletion policies work.
implementation_expectation: typed write, review, promotion, supersession, and deletion lifecycle
planned_verification: Exercise every lifecycle transition and compare schemas, policy decisions, canonical diffs, current/historical recall, and receipts.

requirement_or_outcome: A clean rebuild from canonical sources succeeds and creates a complete receipt.
implementation_expectation: clean canonical-source rebuild with complete generation receipt
planned_verification: Delete derived storage, rebuild, activate only after validation, and reconcile every required receipt field and source ID.

requirement_or_outcome: Provider-neutral export and import succeed.
implementation_expectation: provider-neutral export and clean import
planned_verification: Round-trip a provider-neutral package into a clean project and verify checksums, provenance, scope, and no canonical overwrite.

requirement_or_outcome: Project isolation, memory-poisoning boundaries, secret exclusions, and destructive-operation controls pass the minimum validation suite.
implementation_expectation: isolation, poisoning, secret, and destructive-control validation
planned_verification: Run the integrated security suite against both fixture projects and runtime-generated secret patterns with zero persisted secret values.

requirement_or_outcome: At least one derived-agent profile demonstrates extension without modifying the base API.
implementation_expectation: proof derived-agent profile that leaves the base API unchanged
planned_verification: Install the approved proof profile, ingest its types, run its golden query, and compare the unchanged base API contract.

requirement_or_outcome: Operator documentation explains installation, security posture, source registration, sync, recall, writes, rebuild, backup, export, and recovery.
implementation_expectation: operator installation, security, source, sync, recall, write, rebuild, backup, export, and recovery documentation
planned_verification: Execute every documented operator command in its stated environment and inspect backup/export/recovery classification and warnings.

requirement_or_outcome: Known limitations and deferred requirements are recorded explicitly.
implementation_expectation: explicit limitation/deferment record tied to release evidence
planned_verification: Compare every failed, blocked, unmeasured, unsupported, or deferred ledger row with the published limitations record.
